topic.title: How to Solve Encoding Issues for CMS Integrations

body.p: To avoid encoding issues when working with a CMS, you might need to override the encoding in an XML declaration and force files to be saved as UTF-8.

Set the following system property to override the encoding:com.oxygenxml.force.utf8.xml.encoding=trueWhen set to true, this property saves XML documents as UTF-8, regardless of the encoding in their XML declarations.
